title: Executive Order No. 161, s. 2022
text:
MALACANAN PALACE
MANILA

BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 161

TRANSFERRING THE OVERSIGHT OF THE FILM DEVELOPMENT
COUNCIL OF THE PHILIPPINES FROM THE DEPARTMENT OF
EDUCATION TO THE DEPARTMENT OF TRADE AND INDUSTRY

WHEREAS, Section 2 of Republic Act (RA) No. 9167 established the Film
Development Council of the Philippines (FDCP) under the Office of the President, to
encourage and undertake activities that will promote the growth and development of
the local film industry, and to develop programs that will enhance the skills and
expertise of Filipino talents necessary for quality film production, among others;

WHEREAS, Executive Order (EO) No. 837 (s. 2009) placed the FDCP under
the oversight of the Department of Education (DepEd), in light of that Department's
mandate to develop the country’s educational system, including the advancement of
film, music and the arts;

WHEREAS, the mandate of the FDCP includes developing the local film
industry, promoting its participation in both domestic and foreign markets, and
formulating and implementing policies and programs to upgrade the art and craft of
filmmaking, as well as encourage the production of films for commercial purposes;

WHEREAS, EO No. 133 (s. 1987) vests in the Department of Trade and
Industry (DTI) the mandate and function of: (i) planning, implementing and
coordinating activities of the government related to trade, industry and investments;
(ii) coordinating efforts for the formulation of long-term industry sectoral plans with the
private sector; and (iii) implementing programs and activities geared towards the
promotion of Philippine exports in overseas markets;

WHEREAS, through FDCP Resolution No. 28 (s. 2021), the members of the
FDCP recommended the transfer of oversight powers over the Council from the
DepEd to the DTI to streamline its programs and strengthen its function to develop the
Philippine cinema as a globally competitive film industry that contributes to the
economic development of the country;

WHEREAS, it is a policy of the government to strengthen and rationalize
oversight functions in the Executive, and further streamline the relevant mandates of
offices for more responsive collaboration and effective performance of functions; and

WHEREAS, Section 17, Article VII of the Constitution provides that the
President shall have control of all executive departments, bureaus and offices;

THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
 
NOW, THEREFORE, I, RODRIGO ROA DUTERTE, President of the Republic
of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by the Constitution and existing
laws, do hereby order:

Section 1. Placing the FDCP under the Oversight of the DTI. Oversight of
the FDCP is hereby transferred from the DepEd to the DTI. The DTI shall exercise its
oversight over the FDCP under the terms governing the relationship of administrative
supervision.

Section 2. Repeal. All orders, rules, regulations and issuances or parts thereof,
which are inconsistent with this Order, are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

Section 3. Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately.

DONE, in the City of Manila, this 27th day of January , in the
year of our Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty-Two.

 

By the President:

A ——t “s
SALVADOR C. MEDIALDEA,

Executive Secretary

 

REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES
